messages:
zoe (People Ops): Quick idea: run a lightweight "Spotlight Sticker & e-Stipend" sprint the week of Sep 6. In-office folks get a sticker + handwritten card; remote folks get a $10 e-stipend. Short 48h nomination window. Low admin, high visibility. Thoughts?
rahul (People Ops): Love it. Keeps recognition frequent. Suggest cap of 2 nominations per person to avoid spam.
emi (Office Ops): I can source stickers + cards locally. Lead time ~7 days. Recommend two packing shifts per office (2 hrs each).
toni (Benefits): Taxwise: $10 e-stipends will likely be non-taxable in US if treated as nominal token, but I'll confirm and post guidance for UK/DE. Also will prepare a one-paragraph manager blurb clarifying this is non-performance recognition.
zoe (People Ops): Ops checklist:
- open nom window Mon Sep 6 for 48h (Zoe)
- sticker/card vendor by Aug 28 (Emi)
- volunteer pack sign-up by Sep 2 (Emi)
- e-stip workflow + payout run (Rahul + Toni)
- comms + manager blurb (Zoe)
rahul (People Ops): I'll own e-stip delivery flow and payroll tagging. Will set up a test run for 10 folks.
emi (Office Ops): I'll post vendor quotes tomorrow and start volunteer sign-up after approval.
toni (Benefits): Will post tax confirmation by Fri.
cheer-bot: Event created: "Spotlight Sticker Sprint" 2027-09-07. Calendar invites pending RSVPs.
zoe (People Ops): If we're all aligned I'll lock timeline and publish comms Friday. :sparkles:
